helicopter.layout: column-major: bytes 0-23 = left 8-px column rows 0-23, 24-47 middle, 48-71 right
helicopter.index: heading 7507 (0 = nose up/north, +1 = 22.5 deg clockwise); +8 mod 16 in the south view (7504<>0)
helicopter.routine: 8CA0 copies frame to 6950, then XORs a rotor overlay; 86AF merges 6950 into the composite chars
helicopter.mask: none: drawn with OR/AND into the composite buffer (see notes)

helicopter_rotor.use: 753A cycles 0-1 -> 7000/7100 normally; when 7515=1 or 7516<>0 it cycles 0-3 -> 6700/6800/6900/6A00. For heading frames >= 10 the XOR loop is patched (8D02 = ADD A,A) so the rotor byte is shifted left 1 px.

helicopter_shadow.layout: 9 chars x 8 bytes; char j = column*3 + k, k=0 bottom, 1 middle, 2 top; a char whose first byte is FF is empty (skipped)
helicopter_shadow.index: same as helicopter (heading, +8 in south view)
helicopter_shadow.routine: 7BB8: each char is ORed into the composite at the ground height under that cell (7A95-7A9D)

aircraft.layout: column-major 3x24 = also 9 chars in column order (char j = col*3 + row)
aircraft.index: aircraft direction byte (record +0, 0-63) >> 2; +8 mod 16 in south view
aircraft.routine: 8995: frame copied to FBE0 (= terrain chars 3C-44) and an AND AA/55 dithered copy to FB98 (chars 33-3B, the shadow); the plane is then drawn as map tiles F6-FE (shadow at ground level, plane 3 rows higher)

explosion.use: crash sequence 9246: 24 steps; sprite buffer 6950 cleared every step (from the zero row at 9300); steps 24-22 redraw the helicopter (8CA0) and steps 24-20 XOR explosion frame 0..4 (92ED, pointer 9243)

winch.layout: 1 byte (8 px) wide, one byte per pixel row; rope pixels (bit 3) above the load. Drawn rows = [ptr - rope_len, ptr + 8): crate ptr F52F (crate body F530-F536), survivor ptr F548 (man F548-F54E)
winch.use: F39A: when the tile under the helicopter (7A85) is a crate (F511 list) or survivor (F515 list) and the winch is lowered (7555), pointer 7557 selects F52F (crate) or F548 (survivor); drawn into the composite column at FDA1
